title: EXP-116 - Hello World Part 8 Phase 1b: Picture Static/Edit Rework and the StaticItem, StaticItemDescription and StaticCost Statics on the Tile Form FX_ItemsTile, with a Close/Reopen Readback
objective: Finish Hello World Part 8 Phase 1 (01:25-03:18) on the User-scope Tile Form FX_ItemsTile (EXP-115): take out the generated FX_PictureStatic label; change FX_PictureEdit to a Static named StaticPicture with Image and Text ImageOnly, No Colon True, Location 0; 0 and Size 8; 4 (the narrated 'square on the left'); add three Statics bound by Binding Type Property: StaticItem (Theme Class FX_Header, Justification Left, FX_Item, Location 9; 0, Size 27; 1.5, No Colon True), StaticItemDescription (Left, FX_Description, Location 9; 2, Size 20; 1.5, No Colon True) and StaticCost (Right, FX_Cost, Location 30; 2, Size 8; 1.5, No Colon True). One Designer Save after each step. The narrated unload of global form objects is not authorized. Findings are observed only.

Task boundary: do only what the current task instruction lists and stop at its end, even when later steps of this brief remain; report the next step instead of performing it. Turn budget (EXP-109, EXP-111): if a task cannot finish, stop only at a step boundary right after a Save (never with an unsaved change, open list, editor or dialog) and report the next step.

Server-event rule (EXP-103-R2 lesson): if any action raises 'The server event processing returned an error', answer OK once, record it and stop blocked for an operator Designer reload; never try another route, retry, close or reopen after that error. Efficiency rules (operator, 2026-10-16): screenshots only for the decisive states named in this brief; do not re-open saved images unless a decision needs it; one untargeted snapshot per step; read only the named sources; never search or read the worker's own session transcript. Lists (EXP-111 lesson): choose a list option by clicking it; never pick options with arrow keys, Enter or Tab while a list is open, because Tab commits the highlighted item. Snapshot size (EXP-114): if an untargeted snapshot is too large to return inline, take targeted snapshots of the needed panel instead (record that); never save snapshots to files.

After each performed step exactly one Designer Save, recording its response and the Save state. Answer an OK-only informational prompt with OK and record it verbatim; any other prompt: record it, choose the non-changing answer (No or Cancel) and stop blocked. Leave every other property unchanged.
